policy.latency_source: client-side wall clock, steady-state median of back-to-back measured requests after warmup; server-side timers kept only as per-framework diagnostics
policy.selection: best lossless profile per case for the hardware this ran on (see each row's profile; configs/benchmark/SELECTED.md lists what the harness selects)
policy.cache: no response cache, no Cache-DiT, no quantized checkpoints
policy.torch_compile: ON for the competitors; sglang runs compile-off by policy (its fused kernels match or beat compiler fusion, measured)
policy.attention: each framework runs its fastest exact-precision attention; no quantized or approximate substitution
policy.version_policy: latest-vs-latest: sglang runs origin/main HEAD, every competitor runs its newest main/release line (no pinned snapshots)
policy.comfyui: New this run. ComfyUI runs API-format graphs built from its official workflow templates, with full-precision weights in place of the templates' fp8/int8/nvfp4 files (ideogram4, released only in FP8, runs that release dequantized to BF16 exactly as sglang's weight-only FP8 computes it, because ComfyUI's own FP8 loader runs W8A8 on sm90+), --gpu-only on Blackwell, and TorchCompileModel in 7 cells. qwen-image-2.1, ideogram4 and the three cells that split CFG across GPUs (qwen-image-2512 true-CFG, LTX-2, Wan2.2) run eager because compile fails there. Splitting CFG is ComfyUI's only multi-GPU path, so single-branch cells run on one GPU.
policy.qwen_image_2512: A tie, not a vLLM-Omni win: the main pass put sglang 5.2% behind (2.776 vs 2.638 s), and two ABAB-interleaved paired reruns on the same box put it 0.7% and 0.8% ahead (2.597 vs 2.616 s, 2.582 vs 2.602 s). Files in reports/b200x4-full-20260925/evidence/.
policy.ideogram4: Corrected 2026-09-26. The first ComfyUI cell (3.18 s) loaded Comfy-Org's fp8_scaled repack, which ComfyUI runs as W8A8 on sm90+ (activations quantized to FP8 in all 211 linears: 2.7% relative error per linear, 1.75x faster GEMMs) and which is per-tensor requantized -- not sglang's weight-only FP8, as this note first claimed. Re-measured on the official FP8 release dequantized to BF16, the weights sglang computes with: 4.16 s. Separately, sglang's own B200 number is held back by masked attention falling onto an sm80 kernel; sgl-project/sglang#41309 measures 2.20 s with that fixed.
policy.h3_ref2va_reference: sglang and vLLM-Omni upscale the ref2va reference image to a 2048-pixel short edge; ComfyUI's nodes never upscale, which gave it about 8x fewer reference tokens (343.5 s, discarded). The harness now pre-resizes the reference by the same rule for ComfyUI (534.7 s).
policy.replaced_cells: Four cells replace their main-pass rows. Re-measured the same day on harness c201f19 (bc439d0 plus the ComfyUI reference resize): LTX-2, every framework, because the main pass read a text_encoder/config.json that sglang's LTX-2.3 overlay materializer had rewritten inside the shared model cache on 2026-09-13; LTX-2.3 sglang, because on the read-only cache the same materializer could not write and the server never started (the rerun materialized into a writable copy; the materializer fix is sgl-project/sglang#41298); MiniMax-H3 ref2va ComfyUI, after the reference fix above. Re-measured 2026-09-26 on harness 4bfdd99: ComfyUI ideogram4 on BF16 weights (see ideogram4).
policy.lightx2v_torch: LightX2V runs torch 2.11, the pin in its official image, because flash-attn does not build against torch 2.14; vLLM-Omni and TRT-LLM run torch 2.13, ComfyUI 2.14.

summary.note: Steady-state single-request latency on 4x NVIDIA B200 183GB, best lossless config per framework. SGLang-Diffusion fastest in 14/15 comparable cases across 16 cases. Throughput is reported separately.

Support lives only on vllm-project/vllm-omni#7759 ('[New model] Qwen-image-2.1 support', opened 2026-09-18, still OPEN as of 2026-09-21); recipes.vllm.ai/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 documents `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 --omni` against that PR checkout and states support is not in a tagged release. Re-classify as soon as #7759 merges.

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

lightx2v.reason: OOM on H100 80GB: LTX-2.3 22B two-stage 121-frame t2av peak exceeds 80GB even with every lossless lever (seq_p_size=2 activation sharding + block cpu_offload + Gemma/VAE offload + exact flash_attn3). Upstream profiles target H200 141GB. THIS VERDICT IS H100-SPECIFIC AND IS BEING APPLIED GLOBALLY -- `status` has no per-hardware form, so the cell is skipped everywhere, including the 4xB200 box (183359 MiB/GPU, ~179GB) where the stated constraint does not hold and upstream's own H200 target is exceeded. Retest on Blackwell before trusting the classification; if it runs, `status` needs a per-hardware form before this can be flipped, or H100 runs will spend ~40 min per attempt re-discovering the OOM. command_profiles below are the best-attempted lossless config, kept for provenance.

trtllm-visual.reason: Not yet classified. Confirm framework support and add a validated command profile, or mark unsupported.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI loads LTX-2.3, but no official workflow reproduces this case: sglang runs LTX-2.3's multimodal guidance in stage 1 (video CFG 3 + STG 1.0 on block 28 + modality 3, audio CFG 7 + STG + modality -- up to four DiT passes per step, LTX23SamplingParams), while ComfyUI's LTX-2.3 T2V template (and the LTX-2.5 one) is the distilled-LoRA fast path at cfg 1. A graph built from LTXVSpatioTemporalGuidance / LTXVModalityGuidance / LTXVDualCFGGuider could match it but has no upstream reference and is not validated.

lightx2v.reason: No tracked LightX2V Cosmos3 serving path in this benchmark.

trtllm-visual.reason: Hangs at startup on the current Cosmos3-Nano checkpoint: trtllm-serve reaches 'Orchestrator is creating IPC executor' / 'using MpiPoolSession to spawn MPI processes' and then produces no output at all -- 40 min in the matrix, and 20 min each at tp=1 and tp=2 in a dedicated probe, so it is not a multi-GPU path issue. The startup log warns 'You are using a model of type cosmos3_omni to instantiate a model of type cosmos3': the checkpoint was re-uploaded 2026-08-26 and declares cosmos3_omni, which tensorrt-llm 1.3.0rc26 does not know. Marked failed rather than left supported so a run does not spend 40 minutes per attempt reaching the same hang. Re-test when trtllm adds cosmos3_omni; the profile is kept below.
